Half Acre Cycling Wednesday Night for Mortals

Chicago, IL · Lincoln Square · Road

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Half Acre Cycling Wednesday Night for Mortals is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:00 pm from Winnemac Park parking lot. About 20 miles, two groups: 16–18 mph and 14–16 mph rolling. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @halfacrecycling the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Half Acre Cycling Wednesday Night for Mortals group ride

A no-drop intro to group riding for beginner and intermediate riders. About 20 miles in two pace groups. Ends at Half Acre Brewery on Balmoral. They ask you to RSVP through the form on their site.
